_about: Which filters each category page shows (PRD 5.9). Key = category path by name: 'L1', 'L1 > L2' or 'L1 > L2 > L3'; the most specific match wins, then 'default'. 'bar' = the dropdowns in the bar (first 4 that have data), 'more' = extra ones in the More filters panel. Filter ids: store, size, price, disc, room, cat. A filter is hidden automatically when the page has no data for it (under 50% of products filled in, or fewer than 2 choices). 'sizeLabel' renames the size filter; 'sizeTile' is the label under the size pictures ({size} is replaced).
